args.title: Juniper Labware freight newsletter summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest newsletter covers "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to a blog article and noting a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (subscriber-only): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
